description: src/methods/quota.rs:31 Quota.resource_type: String. RFC 9425 §4.1.1 enumerates only 'octets' and 'count'. Sibling field QuotaScope (types.rs:60) follows the workspace 'in-scope result enum' pattern with Unknown(String) catch-all. resource_type doesn't. Should be a #[non_exhaustive] enum { Octets, Count, Unknown(String) } matching the QuotaScope idiom and the workspace AGENTS.md 'Extras-preservation policy' for result enums. Round-trip preservation test required per same policy.
title: Quota.resource_type typed as String not enum, breaks consistency with QuotaScope
